title: Utility Standing and Home-Site Lease Repayment Plan Length — Training Cases
content:
**Training note: the site's utility account and the length of a repayment plan**

The site's utility standing, read from the Utility Pass-Through Service account serving the leased site, adjusts the length of a Home-Site Lease repayment plan in plan months.

**Rule.** No utility late fee in the trailing 12 calendar months together with a utility balance of zero or a credit adds 1 plan month. A utility late fee in that window, or a utility balance above 100.00, adds -1 plan month, that is, takes one away. Otherwise there is no adjustment.

| Utility late fee in the trailing 12 calendar months | Utility balance | Plan-month adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| none | zero or a credit | 1 added |
| none | owing, up to and including 100.00 | none |
| none | owing, above 100.00 | -1 (one taken away) |
| one or more | any | -1 (one taken away) |

### Cases

1. *No utility late fee in the past year, balance 0.00* — 1 plan month added.
2. *No late fee, balance 100.00* — not above 100.00: no adjustment.
3. *No late fee, balance 100.01* — above 100.00: one plan month taken away.
4. *A utility late fee posted four months ago, balance a credit of 12.00* — one plan month taken away.
5. *The only utility late fee posted fourteen months ago, balance 0.00* — outside the window: 1 plan month added.

The account read is the Utility Pass-Through Service statement account serving the site, not the rent ledger of the Home-Site Lease.
